name: Elaborate Trapper
body:
Drawbacks
Elaborate Trapper
Source Kobolds of Golarion pg. 18
Category Race
Requirement(s) Kobold
You’re blessed with a devious mind, and the more elaborate your traps are, the more effective they become. When creating a trap, if your Craft (trap) roll exceeds the DC of the check by 5 or more, that trap’s Disable Device DC increases by 2.
